An abort with a reason OUTSIDE the frozen list also fails its run (unregistered law behaviour).

checks.RC1_law_version_v22: PER RUN: every wall_events.jsonl row carrying law_version, plus branch_record.json law_version and RUN_RECEIPT.json law_version, equals 'wall-v2.2-merge-release' (FAIL otherwise)

checks.RC3_hold_cap_row_and_receipt: PER RUN: wall_events.jsonl has exactly ONE hold_cap row (so the wall assembled and finished) with requested_hold_s == 240.0 and cap_point_s == 2644.2; RUN_RECEIPT.json exists with wall_summary present, exit_status == 'complete', load_state_calls == 1, horizon_mode == 'smoke_cap', physics_rows_written == 600 (FAIL if the row or any receipt field is missing)
checks.RC4_no_terminal_event_past_merge_start: PER RUN: with lead = branch_record.lead_s_road_at_release_m and v = branch_record.wall_speed_mps: if outcome == 'merge_released' then exactly ONE wall_event merge_release with release_point_s == 2644.2 and 2644.2 - 1e-6 <= lead < 2644.2 + v + 1e-6 (release at the point, at most one control tick of travel past it); for ANY OTHER terminal outcome (assembled_released / aborted_in_hold / aborted_in_assembly) lead, when not null, must satisfy lead <= 2644.2 + 1e-6. FAIL if a release or abort happens with the lead PAST the merge start beyond the release window (the cap fired late or not at all)
checks.RC5_merge_release_observed: ACROSS RUNS: at least ONE run has branch_record.outcome == 'merge_released' with its hold_cap row capped_at_merge == true and branch_record.merge_release_s set; in that run no wall_member_lanes row BEFORE the release tick shows a member on edge 1487606179 or 1487606178 (no member reaches the merge edge while held)
checks.RC4b_no_member_past_merge_start_in_wall: PER RUN: no wall_member_lanes row while the wall is active (from assembly to the release/abort tick, exclusive) shows any member on edge 1487606179 (merge) or 1487606178 (exit) or with s_road > 2644.2 (FAIL otherwise)
checks.RC6_no_collision_no_teleport: PER RUN: RUN_RECEIPT.json reports collisions == 0 and teleports == 0 (integrity counts only; FAIL otherwise)

pass_rule: ALL THREE runs execute (no stop-on-fail). PASS requires: RC1, RC2, RC3, RC4, RC4b, RC6 for EACH run AND RC5 across the runs. A registered safety abort (abort_rule) never fails.
